description: Open the financial aid dispute tracker at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/financial_aid_dispute.xlsx. The spreadsheet has 5 sheets tracking a $2,400 financial aid error. Your tasks: (1) In 'EFC Calculation Comparison' sheet, highlight the error row (row 7) in YELLOW and format the discrepancy amount (E9) in BOLD RED. (2) In 'Communication Log' sheet, apply color coding to the 'Follow-up Needed' column (H): YES=red, IN PROGRESS=yellow, ESCALATE=dark red. (3) In 'Document Tracker' sheet, color code the 'Status' column (F): CONFIRMED=green, SUBMITTED=blue, PENDING REVIEW=orange. (4) In 'Financial Impact Scenarios' sheet, create formulas: B4 should calculate B3+2400, B8 should calculate B5-B4, B11 should calculate (B5-B3)+150, B13 should calculate B11-B8. (5) In 'Deadline Tracker' sheet, apply color coding to 'Days Remaining' column (C): <20 days=RED background, 20-30=YELLOW background, >30=GREEN background. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
